module: Geometric catalog of the Track Builder "pieces" (hex, square, free). Each function receives a piece's parameters and returns, from the previous piece (the 'tipPiece' stored by toSegment), a table describing the new end: position, origin, hdg (heading in radians), polyMult (point density) and pointsType ('bezier', 'arc' or 'custom'), with control points (controlPointA/B), radius/angle or custom points. toSegment is the entry point: it chooses the function according to piece.piece (init, hexForward, hexCurve, freeBezier, hexLoop, etc.).
usage: local seg = util_trackBuilder_pieces.toSegment({piece = 'hexCurve', length = 4, direction = 1, hardness = 0}, tip)
notes: The heading hdg is in radians; getHdgVector(hdg) = (sin hdg, cos hdg, 0): heading 0 points toward +Y.
Hex scale: lateral offset multiplied by sqrt(3)/2; hex curves use radiusMult = sqrt(3), square 1. Hex angles are steps of pi/3, square pi/2, free in degrees (converted).
toSegment stores tip in a local variable (tipPiece) used by all the other functions: they are usable only after a call to toSegment (unless tipPiece was set by a previous call).

Probable bug: customBezier always calls M.splineTrack.getTrackPosition(), even without absolute, but M.splineTrack is nil in this file (the field must be set from outside by splineTrack); emptyOffset with absolute uses it too.
Bug: freeSpiral leaves forwardCPLength and backwardCPLength as nil if angle > 75° (pi*75/180), which causes an arithmetic error.
fresnelSC references an undefined global variable 'subs' (nil, no effect).
emptyOffset with absolute modifies tipPiece.position and tipPiece.hdg (side effect).

splineTrack.desc: Reference to the splineTrack module, nil in this file; must provide getTrackPosition() for absolute-positioned pieces.

toSegment.desc: Converts the piece description into a segment table. Stores tip as the previous piece then delegates to initialTrackPiece, forward, curve, offsetCurve, customBezier, hexSpiral, squareSpiral, freeSpiral, loop or emptyOffset according to piece.piece. Returns nil if the type is unknown.

piece.desc: Piece description (field piece = type name, plus length, direction, hardness, radius, xOffset, xOff, yOff, zOff, dirOff, size, inside, angle, absolute, empty… depending on the type).

initialTrackPiece.desc: Initial piece: position (0,0,0) and heading 0 by default, with no points.

p.desc: Optional table with position (vec3) and hdg (rad).

getHdgVector.desc: Returns the horizontal unit vector of the heading: (sin hdg, cos hdg, 0).

forward.desc: Straight line of the given length in the direction of the tipPiece (control points at 25% of the length).

bezierCurve.desc: Bézier curve approximating an arc (constant 0.5523); hardness changes the length of the tangents (negative: reduces, positive: increases).

curve.desc: Turn of given radius and angle. If hardness is non-zero, goes through bezierCurve; otherwise returns an arc ('arc') with radius, angle and direction.

hardness.desc: Hardness; 0 or nil for a pure arc.

offsetCurve.desc: S-curve of given length offset laterally by xOffset; in hex, adds 0.5 to the length if xOffset is odd to stay on the triangular grid.

xOffset.desc: Lateral offset (positive toward the right of the heading).

customBezier.desc: Free Bézier: offset (xOff, yOff), heading change dirOff and forward/backward tangent lengths. In absolute mode, the offset is computed from the current position of the track cursor (splineTrack.getTrackPosition()). Also returns local and global positions/headings.

absolute.desc: Position relative to the track cursor rather than to the last piece.

empty.desc: If true, no geometry is generated (noPoints).

returns.desc: Piece of type 'bezier' (with globalPosition, localPosition, globalHdg, localHdg).

emptyOffset.desc: Moves the track cursor without generating geometry (noPoints). Can also change the heading (dirOff in steps of pi/3 in hex, pi/2 otherwise) and the height (zOff).

absolute.desc: Starts from the position of the track cursor.

hexSpiral.desc: Hexagonal spiral (60° turn) inward or outward, described by a Bézier.

squareSpiral.desc: Square spiral (90° turn), same principle as hexSpiral.

freeSpiral.desc: Free-angle spiral; the tangent lengths are chosen in 15° increments up to 75°.

angle.desc: Angle in radians (at most 75° = 1.309 rad, otherwise error).

fresnelSC.desc: Helper function for loops: numerically integrates the Euler spiral (clothoid, Fresnel integrals cos/sin(t²·pi/2)) from 0 to d.

loop.desc: Vertical loop built with a clothoid, with lateral offset xOffset spread out as a gentle slope; returns up to 300 custom points (position, rot).

xOffset.desc: Lateral offset between entry and exit.
